class.name: HEGoGraphOutput
class.brief_description: Turns output points flagged as graph points into [HEGoGraph3D] nodes under [code]Outputs/[/code].
class.description:
Houdini polylines reach Godot through the loose-point output: the HDA keeps its curve points (Add SOP, "Delete Geometry But Keep the Points") and links each point to the one before it on its curve.
[b]Point attributes the HDA sets[/b] [br]- [code]hego_graph[/code] (int): 1 on every graph point. Other points are left to the other handlers. [br]- [code]hego_graph_path[/code] (string, optional): node path under [code]Outputs[/code] of the graph the point belongs to, default [code]Graph[/code]. One cook can build several graphs. [br]- [code]hego_graph_id[/code] (int, optional): an id unique within the cook, default the point number. [br]- [code]hego_graph_prev[/code] (int, optional): the id of the point this one connects to, -1 for none. A polyline links every point but the first to its predecessor; a shared id (a fork point) joins curves into one graph. [br]- [code]hego_graph_conn_<name>[/code]: becomes the connection attribute [code]<name>[/code] of the connection from this point to its predecessor. [br]- Every other point attribute except [code]P[/code] and the [code]hego_[/code] prefix becomes a point attribute of the graph, declared on an [code]Attributes[/code] child: floats, ints, strings and three-float vectors.
A graph built this way edits, saves and feeds another cook like an authored one.

method.name: output_phase
method.description: Name of the cook phase this handler is timed under.

method.name: should_handle
method.description: Whether the cook produced graph points.

method.name: handle
method.description: Fetches the graph points and builds one [HEGoGraph3D] per [code]hego_graph_path[/code].
